item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E3: The earlier row (2026-09-22) says the festival was held on Parcel…
item.description: The earlier row (2026-09-22) says the festival was held on Parcel E3 and that a July 2026 release said the campus would open in phases beginning September 2026. Elevation Sky Park's page: "RASA World transformed the future home of Elevation Sky Park into the backdrop for Pier Play" and "Pier 70"; "Parcel E3" is not on it, nor in the Port's August 2026 Item 11A or its minutes. Business Wire release of 2026-07-23 (copy on Yahoo Finance): "ESP SF opens in phases beginning September 2026". Parcel E3 is the record's own attribution, not stated by a source read. The earlier row is left as written. Source: https://elevationskypark.com/; https://finance.yahoo.com/media-advertising/articles/blond-ish-headline-pier-play-190100358.html.
item.source: https://elevationskypark.com/; https://finance.yahoo.com/media-advertising/articles/blond-ish-headline-pier-play-190100358.html

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E3: The 2026-09-29 entry for this record said the Brookfield…
item.description: The 2026-09-29 entry for this record said the Brookfield construction halt could only be dated to 2022, because neither source gives the month. That left out what Bisnow reports: its October 20, 2022 article says 'progress stalled in April', after 'a work stoppage earlier this year', so the halt is dated April 2022 (the year follows from 'earlier this year' in an October 2022 article). Bisnow is describing the 28-acre Pier 70 project's first phase as a whole, not this parcel in particular. The Real Deal's April 17, 2023 article says only that the developer halted construction 'last year'. The milestone stays marked approximate. Source: Bisnow, 2022-10-20 (https://www.bisnow.com/san-francisco/news/mixed-use/brookfield-properties-and-port-of-san-francisco-inch-closer-to-pier-70-completion-115959); The Real Deal, 2023-04-17 (https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2023/04/17/brookfield-leases-first-seven-tenants-at-pier-70/).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E3: Parcel E3 now says the SF Chronicle (June 10, 2025) reported that…
item.description: Parcel E3 now says the SF Chronicle (June 10, 2025) reported that Elevation XR has signed a five-year lease and that the operator's June 25, 2025 community deck proposes a five-year period; no lease or Port approval document has been read, and the deck's target opening of Q1 2026 has passed. The Elevation Sky Park entry now places it at Pier 70 where 22nd Street meets the Bay, and says that Parcel E3 is Pier & Point's own reading. Source: SF Chronicle, 2025-06-10 (sfchronicle.com/bayarea/article/entertainment-complex-pier-70-20368547.php); Port-hosted ESP community engagement deck, 2025-06-25 (sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/Community%20Engagement%20Deck%20(SHORT)%206.25.25_ESP%20SF%20(1).pdf); Port Commission minutes, 2025-07-08 (sfport.com/media/10661/download?inline=).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E3: Parcel E3 was shown as existing on the strength of Elevation Sky…
item.description: Parcel E3 was shown as existing on the strength of Elevation Sky Park's July 2026 announcement that it would open with Pier Play San Francisco on Sep 19. The venue's own page (published Sep 25, 2026, checked Sep 29, 2026) confirms Pier Play San Francisco was held on Sep 19, 2026, but calls the site 'the future home of Elevation Sky Park' and gives no opening date, so E3 now shows as planned and the venue's tenant listing as announced. The record now cites that page instead of pre-event announcements and no longer says the venue 'opened to the public' or is 'fully permitted' (the June 2025 deck says 'will be fully permitted'). The 2017 approval milestone is tagged planned, not existing; the unlinked SFGATE rendering is no longer relied on; the map notes no longer say the block has no Assessor lot; and the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission minutes now back the informational hearing. Placing the venue on Parcel E3 remains Pier & Point's own mapping decision. The Brookfield construction halt is dated 2022 (approximate) rather than April 2022, since neither source gives the month, and the Board of Supervisors vote on the Development Agreement shows first reading Oct 31 and final passage Nov 14, 2017. Source: Elevation XR, Elevation Sky Park website, Pier Play recap, 2026-09-25 (https://elevationskypark.com/); Elevation XR, Elevation Sky Park SF community engagement deck, 2025-06-25 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-06/Community%20Engagement%20Deck%20(SHORT)%206.25.25_ESP%20SF%20(1).pdf); Business Wire via Yahoo Finance, 2026-07-23 (https://finance.yahoo.com/media-advertising/articles/blond-ish-headline-pier-play-190100358.html); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2026-08-11 (https://www.sfport.com/media/11558/download?inline); San Francisco Board of Supervisors, Ordinance No. 224-17 (https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/o0224-17.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel E3: Port Commission hears an informational report (staff… (Aug 11, 2026)
item.description: Port Commission hears an informational report (staff report dated Aug 7; no action taken) on proposed DDA amendments: parcel-specific outside dates, a Project-wide affordable rate of no less than 20% (327 stand-alone affordable units kept), 65-to-90 ft height increases on certain residential parcels, developer return cut from 18% to 14%, and a new phasing plan (Aug 11, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel E3: Port Commission: Port staff and the… (late 2026 or early 2027)
item.description: Port Commission: Port staff and the developer are drafting amendments to the DDA and related transaction documents "for consideration by the Port Commission and Board of Supervisors by the end of this year or early next year" (Item 11A, memo of Aug 7, 2026, p.2 and p.6). Port Commission minutes of Aug 11, 2026 (p.7): staff and Brookfield "expect to return with proposed amendments in late 2026 or early 2027". The source gives no hearing date. The date shown is the early end of that window (December 2026); "early next year" falls in 2027. The same report proposes extending the term of the DDA, Development Agreement and Master Lease by 5 years. (late 2026 or early 2027). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel E3: Brookfield halts construction on the 28-Acre Site: The… (~Apr 2022)
item.description: Brookfield halts construction on the 28-Acre Site: The Real Deal (Apr 27, 2022, citing the San Francisco Business Times) reports 'Brookfield has halted construction' because of economic conditions, and Bisnow (Oct 20, 2022) reports that after the first phase's infrastructure and roadwork were completed 'progress stalled in April, with officials citing market conditions'. The Port's Aug 2026 report says the balance of Phase 1 horizontal work, largely the parks, is still to be built, so this was not the end of all Phase 1 horizontal work; The Real Deal (Apr 17, 2023) adds that the developer 'halted construction last year toward the end of the first of three planned phases of construction'. The stall concerns the 28-Acre Site project, not this parcel specifically (~Apr 2022). Source: The Real Deal (citing San Francisco Business Times), 2022-04-27; Bisnow (Joseph Gordon), 2022-10-20; The Real Deal (citing SF Business Times), 2023-04-17; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.
item.source: The Real Deal (citing San Francisco Business Times), 2022-04-27; Bisnow (Joseph Gordon), 2022-10-20; The Real Deal (citing SF Business Times), 2023-04-17; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07
